nodes.product: ultrasound diagnostic systems OEM - buyer of Leeno Industrial's ultrasound-probe components (medical-device segment customer)
precision-machining affiliate run by the brother of Leeno Industrial's CEO (no equity link) - minor two-way trade in pins/sockets and parts

edges.relationship: ultrasound-probe components (medical-device parts, flex and precision parts) supplied by Leeno Industrial to Siemens ultrasound systems under a strategic partnership since 2010

contracts.signal: Leeno's half-year report (filed 08-14-2026) states that since 2010 it has held a strategic partnership with Siemens, supplying ultrasound-probe components, and describes Siemens as a customer that exports its self-developed ultrasound probes worldwide and is building a medical-device/IT convergence base - a stable, consumable-type revenue stream. No Siemens-specific amount is disclosed; the medical-device segment booked KRW 18,574,688K of parts sales in H1 2026 (7.65% of revenue; domestic KRW 17,377,973K, export KRW 1,196,715K) plus KRW 1,455,972K of merchandise, vs KRW 38,137,860K parts sales in FY2025. H1 2026 medical-parts output 1,557,948 units.
contracts.value: no specific figure (medical-device segment KRW 20,030,660K in H1 2026, 8.25% of revenue)
contracts.date_signed: 2010 (strategic partnership start; exact date not stated)

edges.relationship: related-party sales of Leeno products to Leeno Precision, the CEO's brother's company

contracts.signal: Leeno's half-year report (filed 08-14-2026, note 29 and section X) discloses related-party sales of goods to Leeno Precision of KRW 220,341,856 in H1 2026 vs KRW 189,040,000 in H1 2025, with receivables of KRW 23,100,000 at 2026-06-30 (KRW 15,400,000 at 2025-12-31). Leeno Precision is run by the brother of CEO Lee Chae-yoon; Leeno Industrial holds no equity in it and there were no fund transactions.

edges.relationship: related-party purchases of parts/services by Leeno Industrial from Leeno Precision

contracts.signal: Leeno's half-year report (filed 08-14-2026, note 29 and section X) discloses purchases from Leeno Precision of KRW 47,680,000 in H1 2026 (none in H1 2025) and a payable of KRW 22,385,000 at 2026-06-30. Leeno states its main raw-material suppliers (pipe etc. KRW 45,417,917,923 and plating materials KRW 17,287,518,643 in H1 2026) are withheld as trade secrets and are not related parties.
